title: What's your efficient process of using AI and other tools for game dev in Unity?
author: MemmorexX
selftext:
I've been trying to use Claude, but I need to give it all my classes files manually because of the conversation length limit.

For smaller things I use GPT.

I do have plenty of experience with Unity/Rider but I want to get a bit more efficient at it.

I tried using Claude in Rider, but it's a bit of a mess at the moment to be honest. 

1. What's a more efficient of doing things, which models do you use, what are some must have prompts?

2. What are some other tools that I should really use for unity?

comments.author: Jewish_Coin
comments.body: Just use antigravity bro. It slaps.

comments.author: Icy-Swordfish7784
comments.body: Use antigravity and direct it to your unity assets folder. The more your prompt communicates what you're trying to achieve, the more accurate it will be in creating scripts that fit those goals.

replies.author: Shnatrix
replies.body: Is there an online version of antigravity like replit?

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
I think AIs can examine files in github so that's another option if you don't want to go full ai agent

Some vibe coding tools I used keep the files in their online folder and there is no file posting, but they don't work with Unity and they use different AIs

For GPT, you can upload files to the project folder so you can try that too

comments.author: Extra_Blacksmith674
comments.body:
Using codex in browser with github connector, zero complaints. It's painless and I love it!  

$20 plan have yet to get close to exhausting my limits, done about 3 months of work in 2 weeks.

But I should probably check out other stuff, only a month in.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
I just prompt GPT for anything I need honestly. Occasionally, GPT misses the mark and I have to pick up the slacks but it is a productivity boost in general. 

The best thing about AI is that they don't give up ever. I haven't had to scrap or abandon any projects out of frustration since I started using AI; I explain why I feel I am stuck and eventually AI will recommend something useful.  

You can try Gemini if you already tried Claude/GPT. Those are already the strongest AIs

There are gamedev special vibecoding tools online but they dont use Unity3d. if you are okay with making html/js games, those are pretty good options imo
